title: Clarity DAO Infrastructure Liquid Democracy Capability

ms.promise: Conduct in-depth analysis of the Clarity Protocol and its current infrastructure.
ms.criteria: Research and document the requirements and specifications for extending the protocol to support vote delegation.
ms.report:
Evidence of milestone
Development team to define the technical implementation plan. Provide documentation of technical implementation plans
Abstract
Agora allows DAO members to stake their tokens and allow someone else to vote on their behalf in a noncustodial way. The delegatee can vote with these tokens but cannot withdraw them.

With this PoA we explain how we will use Agora, CTL, and our front end to create a feature where users can delegate their vote.
Implementation plan
Staked tokens in Agora support a DelegateTo redeemer that allows to specify a public key hash of a user that gets voting rights of that stake, but they cannot change it or withdraw staked tokens. Instead, the tokens remain locked in validator where only the stake owner can withdraw them.
We will implement an off-chain workflow using CTL that allows user to control stake delegations, expand our specialized block indexer to keep track of stake delegations, expose queries so users can see who delegated their stakes to them, and integrate everything with our current frontend.
Agora: https://github.com/Liqwid-Labs/agora/blob/staging/agora/Agora/Stake/Scripts.hs#L595-L600
CTL workflows
CTL workflows are off-chain code that collects data from a chain indexer, interacts with the blockchain, and submits transactions. We will implement a workflow that allows a user to delegate their stake to another user, undelegate previously a delegated stake to regain full control over voting rights, and expand voting workflow to support voting with not only a user’s owned stakes, but delegated stakes as well.
Chain indexer
We are using specialized chain indexer that rather than indexing every utxo on the blockchain. Our chain indexer only checks utxos that are relevant to the protocol in a structured way, allowing for quick lookups and live updates as new blocks land on-chain. We will expand it to keep track of delegations in addition to tracking stake owners.
